title: Intrinsic comparison of the two first embedded reductions
statement: Let ell be prime, E a finite intermediate field of PadicAlgCl ell, pi a generator of the maximal ideal of its integer ring, X a Noetherian scheme and K an arbitrary derived complex of continuous integral module objects, as in [def-sfb-embedded-integral-model-coefficients]. Assume the actual quotient completedResidue ell E pi 0 is finite and discrete. The finiteRealization of [def-sfb-embedded-finite-coefficient-realization] applied to the first constant reduction of restriction K is isomorphic to integralModelIntrinsicRealization applied to its first continuous reduction. Both functors use the given quotient maps. No constructibility, Tor amplitude or completeness is asserted or assumed.

proof.text: Invert the specified finite residue scalar map. Choose a K-flat complex P quasi-isomorphic to a cochain representative of K. Restriction of embedded integral scalars preserves K-flatness.

Apply the left derived functor counits on P and its restricted complex. These are isomorphisms by K-flatness; scalar extension along the finite residue isomorphism is exact, so its counit is also invertible. Apply the ordinary natural comparison degreewise and localize to identify the two derived first reductions.

Apply the right derived intrinsic realization to this isomorphism. Transport along the quasi-isomorphism from P to K using the two specified realization functors. This uses no boundedness, Tor, constructibility or completeness condition.

theorem firstReductionComparison
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ)
    (π : PadicAlgCl.integers ℓ E.1)
    (hπ : Ideal.span {π} = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (PadicAlgCl.integers ℓ E.1))
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X]
    [Finite (completedResidue ℓ E π 0)] [DiscreteTopology (completedResidue ℓ E π 0)]
    (K : DerivedCategory.{u + 1} (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
      (integralCoefficientObject X ℓ E))) :
    letI : HasSheafify (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} :=
      CategoryTheory.siteAbelianHasSheafify.{u + 1, u, u + 1} _
    letI : (Scheme.ProEt.topology X).WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} :=
      CategoryTheory.siteAbelianWEqualsLocallyBijective.{u + 1, u, u + 1} _
    Nonempty
      ((constantResidueRealization ℓ E π X).obj K ≅
        (continuousResidueRealization ℓ E π X).obj K)
